summary: Global Business Travel Group Inc. (GBTG) entered into a definitive Merger Agreement to be acquired by Long Lake Management Holdings Inc. via a merger, with the company surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary of the acquirer. The filing does not specify the per-share price, premium, or total equity value. A special committee of independent and disinterested directors unanimously approved and recommended the deal, with the full board concurring and recommending stockholder adoption under Delaware law. The transaction requires stockholder approval; no deal timetable, termination fee, or regulatory timeline is disclosed. Investors should watch for the proxy statement filing revealing price and the risk of stockholder opposition.
